summary: BUG-054 keyboard navigation code review for DirectDispatchForm.jsx. Could not run live UI tests — all 3 credential sets failing with 401 from MyGenie preprod API (external service). Conducted thorough code-level verification of all 3 changes.
action_items: MyGenie preprod API returning 401 for all 3 credential sets (manager@germanfluid.com, manager@centralkitchenalpha.com, manager@outletdirectone.com) — main agent must restore preprod access before live UI testing is possible
critical_code_review_comments: B1+B3 (search Enter): getFilteredGrouped() uses React state `searchText` which is updated async via onChange. Since Enter key is pressed after typing (not during), state is already updated — implementation is correct.
B2 (qty disabled guard): disabled={submitting} correctly removes the !row.included guard — qty field is always editable. PASS.
B3+B4 (qty Enter): Correctly auto-checks row if qty>0 && !included, then jumps focus to next dispatch-qty-* input using DOM querySelectorAll. PASS.
V4 regression: includedRows filter is `r.included && Number(r.qty) > 0 && r.sourceSelector` — unchecked rows are excluded from submit payload. PASS by code review.
V5 FEFO: updateDispatchRow re-runs fefoAutoSelect on every qty change (pre-existing logic, unchanged). PASS.
V6 search/filter/pills/SelectAll/UnselectAll: None of the existing filter logic was touched. PASS.

All 6 tests need live verification.
